description: PAID. Costs one interval of the first machine in the door's ranking that runs it within this server's cap (hosts set their own price; 0.007 USDC an hour today; see charter_offers), paid from this server's own wallet in USDC on Base. Hosts are run by independent operators, not vetted by Charter. Loads up to five http or https pages in a headless browser on a rented machine and returns each page's text. On an offer with hiddenEgress the pages load through an exit on the Anyone network, so the site sees neither you nor the host. Useful when a page needs JavaScript or your own address is refused. Slow (a page can take a minute) and some sites refuse shared exits. If it is still running when the wait ends, charter_lease collects the output for free.

urls.description: one to five http or https URLs

waitSeconds.description: how long to wait for the job before handing back the leaseId (default 40, under most clients' 60 s tool timeout; pages often need longer, so expect to collect with charter_lease)

name: charter_fetch_pages
title: Fetch pages in a headless browser
